lessons: A condition written down in advance is worth more than one recognised afterwards. Tonight's refusal survived a test it could have failed; the six before it were never at risk, and that difference is not visible unless the test was written first.
A source answering 404 once is an outage, not a death. The page that called it dead had exactly one observation and drew a trend from it.

The rule 'every number is copied from the pack' is not a formality. A table typed from memory inverted a name's direction for a whole session, and the error was only visible because a second page computed the same session from the pack.

Evidence quality and outcome probability are different quantities. Tonight's evidence made the refusal better founded and said nothing about the next 21 sessions, so the confidence stayed where it was.

A cap that excludes a name also excludes its evidence. The only real document collected today belongs to a name this book cannot size, which means better collection does not by itself produce better decisions.
A reason that is appended last is the first thing a truncation removes. The eodhd explanation is cut at 400 characters exactly where it starts explaining.
